title: Vice Got a Price! — The Leonida Platinum Companion
listNote: The official 55-trophy PlayStation 5 list, public since 18 November 2026: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 of them hidden until earned. Names, descriptions and grades are shown exactly as PlayStation publishes them; every guide below is written for this companion in our own words and names its sources.
ratesNote: Earn rates are the Exophase launch-night snapshot of 19 November 2026 (638 tracked players), so almost everything reads ultra-rare while the player base is hours old. Rates only ever climb from here.

estimate.hours: About 200 hours to the platinum (community estimate)
estimate.difficulty: Difficulty about 4 of 10: long, not hard (community estimate)
estimate.online: Online trophies: none. Every trophy is single-player.
estimate.source: Estimates as reported by GTA Vibes and Output Lag at launch; Rockstar publishes neither figure.

roadmap.name: Chapters 1–2: the story opens
roadmap.summary: Play the opening chapters and let the story trophies fall. Two habits start here and protect the whole run: keep a manual save at the start of every chapter (there is no mission replay), and never touch a cheat code on this save (cheats reportedly disable trophies and saving for the session).
tips: During Chapter 1, meditate on Lucia's balcony: that spot counts toward Positive Mental Attitude and disappears when the chapter ends — the one launch-confirmed missable.
From Chapter 2 both Lucia and Jason are playable, which unlocks the partner trophies; weave them into free roam instead of grinding them later.

roadmap.name: Chapters 3–4 and the finale
roadmap.summary: Finish the story. The named mission trophies pop in story order, the robbery set opens across Chapters 3 and 4, and the gold finale trophy closes the arc. Save manually before the final mission: any one-chance feat tied to the endgame needs that save behind it.
tips: Chapter trophies themselves cannot be missed; they are awarded for completion, not performance.
If a one-chance feat goes wrong during a mission, reload the chapter-start save rather than playing on.

roadmap.name: Partners and strangers
roadmap.summary: With both leads playable, clear the partner feats (a shared 4-star escape, the three-shop robbery chain, the partnership moment) and finish every stranger strand: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret's hunt, which together also complete the Strangers & Freaks silver.
tips: A stranger strand only counts when its final mission is done — finish strands, do not just start them.
Stranger markers reappear as the story and free roam progress; if a contact goes quiet, advance the story and check the map again.

roadmap.name: The robbery circuit
roadmap.summary: Jewelry stores, five bank vaults, an armored truck and one illegal operation from each of the nine gangs. Every robbery trophy is really an escape trophy: plan the getaway before the job, and let the wanted level, not the loot, decide when you run.
tips: Rob a different gang's operation each time for Pest Control; repeat hits on one gang do not advance its count.
The robbery circuit funds the money trophies: marked bills feed Dime on the Dollar, and the take pays for the garages in Little Boxes.

roadmap.name: Activities and feats
roadmap.summary: The skill and sampler set: 250 stunts, gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, a drone-race win at all 14 locations, 20 different race wins, fishing against Cal, an arcade game, 50 challenges and bowling — plus the one-off feats (Combat Focus five-in-one, the VCIA departure, the Rhino, the showroom exit).
tips: Try each activity type once early (Master of None) so you know which ones you enjoy; the long counts then grind themselves down in the background.
The Shootist is the skill gate of this stage: learn each weapon class's target pattern before chasing golds.

roadmap.name: Collectibles, the map and the money
roadmap.summary: Sweep Leonida: the remaining meditation spots, 3 full card sets, 100 WAiNK photo spots, 100 discovered vehicles, all 52 areas, 10 Scooter Bros registrations, 500 choices, $250,000 laundered, $100,000 spent and all 8 garages bought.
tips: Do collectibles region by region as the story takes you there; a single end-game sweep of 100 photo spots is a slog, a habit is not.
Swap cars constantly: every new model you sit in counts toward Whip It Good, and the keepers fill your Scooter Bros registrations.

roadmap.name: 100% and the platinum
roadmap.summary: Close out the in-game 100% tracker for the A Long Road gold, using the stage order above to find whatever category is short. The moment the last of the 54 lands, Vice Got a Price! completes the set.
tips: The 100% tracker counts categories, not every collectible in the game; check its breakdown in-game before chasing spares.
Community estimates put the full run near 200 hours: pace the grind, it is a marathon trophy list, not a hard one.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum, awarded the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is no separate task behind it. Everything in this companion funnels into it: the story, the full 100% completion tracker (the A Long Road gold) and every side count. Two protections for the whole run, reported across launch coverage: cheats disable trophies for the session and block saving (PowerPyx, via PlanetGTA6), so never test a code on this save; and with no mission replay in the game, keep a manual save at the start of every chapter.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase; PowerPyx cheat report via PlanetGTA6; Push Square launch report.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Gone Fishing, the opening mission, which doubles as the game's tutorial stretch. It cannot be missed: simply play the intro. Its launch earn rate sits at 100% on Exophase because every tracked player has, by definition, started the game.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1 of the story; the trophy is awarded for finishing the chapter, not for any score or medal. Before the chapter closes, do the one thing this chapter can take away from you: meditate on Lucia's balcony, because that meditation spot counts toward Positive Mental Attitude and disappears once Chapter 1 ends (reported by Output Lag). Start the manual-save habit here too.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase; Output Lag launch list (balcony meditation).

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. The asterisks are in the name as PlayStation publishes it. From this chapter both Lucia and Jason are playable (Output Lag), which is what unlocks the partner trophies — Hot Together, Retail Therapy and Personal Best — so start weaving those into free roam now rather than grinding them at the end.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase; Output Lag launch list (both leads playable from Chapter 2).

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Across Chapters 3 and 4 the robbery set opens up (Output Lag): jewelry stores, bank vaults and armored trucks become available targets, so Sneakthief, Maximum Withdrawal and A Classic Blitz Play all start here even though this companion's roadmap sweeps them up as their own stage.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase; Output Lag launch list (robbery trophies in Chapters 3–4).

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4, the last full chapter before the endgame. Make a manual save as the finale approaches: the game has no mission replay (reported by Output Lag and the Vice City Hub), so any one-chance feat tied to the final missions needs a save behind it rather than a new playthrough.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase; Output Lag launch list (no mission replay).

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission — the gold capstone of the story set. Keep a manual save from immediately before the mission starts. If anything one-chance goes wrong in the finale, reload that save; with no mission replay, playing on past a mistake is the expensive option.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Like every named-mission trophy in this set, it is awarded on completion alone — the official description asks for no medal, time or score, so play it clean and move on.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. A scripted heist rather than a free-roam robbery: finish the mission and the trophy follows. The free-roam robbery trophies (Sneakthief, Maximum Withdrawal, A Classic Blitz Play) are separate and open across Chapters 3–4.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Awarded on completion; nothing in the official description adds a performance condition.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Awarded on completion; the official description names no extra condition.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown — VCIA is Vice City International Airport, the same airport Catch Me If You Can later sends you back to for an unscheduled departure. Finish the mission and the trophy is yours.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Awarded on completion; the official description adds no performance condition.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion on the game's own completion tracker — the second gold and the long pole of the platinum. Push Square's launch report underlines that the platinum demands the full 100%, not merely the story, following the pattern of every Rockstar list since the PS3 era. Work the tracker's categories in this companion's stage order (strangers, robberies, activities, collectibles, exploration) and check the in-game percentage breakdown before chasing spares: the tracker counts categories, not every last collectible. Community estimates put the whole platinum near 200 hours (GTA Vibes; Output Lag) — an estimate, not a promise.
steps: Finish the story first; several categories only fully open afterwards.
Clear stranger strands and the robbery circuit next — they pay cash the money trophies need.
Sweep activities and collectibles region by region, then read the in-game 100% breakdown and mop up the short category.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase; Push Square launch report; GTA Vibes and Output Lag time estimates.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — the stunt jumps and stunt events scattered across Leonida, which the map marks once you discover them. The count is the whole job: never drive past a marked stunt without taking it, and work region by region so the last fifty are a sweep, not a scavenger hunt. Stunts also feed the 100% completion tracker.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase (requirement and count as published).

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once — the count behind the description is 9 activity types. Sample one of everything as it unlocks: a race, a Shooting Range challenge, a Top Fun drone race, a fishing trip, an arcade game, a bowling game and the rest of the marked pastimes. Treat it as a guided tour: it shows you exactly what the longer activity trophies will ask of you later.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase (9 activity types as listed with the trophy).

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges — every challenge, not a selection. This is the skill gate of the activities set. Learn each weapon class's target pattern on a sighting run first (accuracy outscores raw speed on the moving-target sets), then chase the golds range by range. Leave the final push until your weapon handling is levelled; the challenges do not change, but you do.
steps: Run each new challenge once to learn its target pattern before scoring it.
Gold the static and slow sets first; bank confidence and medals.
Finish with the moving-target sets once your aim perks are levelled.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase (42 challenges as listed with the trophy).

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location — 14 locations, and the description says win, not finish. Take a practice lap to learn each course's racing line, then run it for the win. The drones handle identically at every venue, so the technique from your first win carries to all fourteen.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase (14 locations as listed with the trophy).

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. The word that matters is different: repeating one easy race twenty times does not advance the count, so keep moving to fresh race markers. Any vehicle class counts — early on, pick races that suit the car you already own and save your cash for the property trophies.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal is the charter captain the story introduces around its fishing beats; take his challenge when it is offered and land your catches cleanly rather than fast. Fishing also feeds 100% completion. A small bragging note from the data: at 2.04% this was the most-earned optional trophy of launch night on Exophase — everyone finds Cal.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase (requirement and launch earn rate).

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game — finish one, not merely start it. Arcade cabinets sit in bars and arcades around Vice City; pick the shortest game on offer if the trophy is all you want, and note the visit also banks one of the nine activity types for Master of None.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy — his whole stranger strand, not just the first meeting. Stranger strands unlock in stages as the story advances; if Andy goes quiet, progress the story and watch the map for his marker to return. His finished strand also counts toward the Strangers & Freaks silver.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton, closing out his stranger strand. As with every strand in this set, only the final mission pays the trophy; earlier meetings are progress, not completion. A finished strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy, closing out his stranger strand. Finish the strand rather than sampling it: the trophy waits at the end of his last job, and the finished strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. The named strands in this list — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, with Bret's hunt beside them — are the backbone of the eight; a strand only counts when its final mission is complete. Work strands to their ends one or two at a time instead of opening all of them, and let the five named strand trophies fall out of the same work.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase (8 strands as published).

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy, closing out his stranger strand. Only the strand's last mission pays; the finished strand also counts toward the Strangers & Freaks silver.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone, closing out his stranger strand. As with the other named strands, the trophy is at the end of the last job, and the finished strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida — 18 spots. This is the one launch-confirmed missable: a spot on Lucia's balcony counts toward the set and disappears once Chapter 1 ends (Output Lag's launch list calls this the one possible missable, and GTA Vibes flags the same trophy). Meditate there during Chapter 1, before anything else on this page. The remaining spots are viewpoint icons — rooftops, piers, lookouts — and can be swept in free roam at any pace afterwards.
steps: Chapter 1: meditate on Lucia's balcony before finishing the chapter. This step cannot be recovered later.
Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter as insurance; there is no mission replay.
Sweep the other 17 spots region by region in free roam, alongside the WAiNK photo spots.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase (18 spots); Output Lag launch list (Chapter 1 balcony spot, one possible missable); GTA Vibes launch list (same flag).

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Take the hunting request when Bret's strand offers it and track the one named animal — this is a single scripted hunt, not a species-study grind. Bring a scoped rifle and use the approach the hunt's own prompts teach; the finished job sits alongside the stranger strands in your completion percentage.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets — three full themed sets, not three loose cards. Cards turn up on counters, bodies and loot spots all over Leonida, so loot everything as you play and the early sets complete themselves. Save the deliberate hunting for the end, then chase the missing cards set by set instead of wandering.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase (3 sets as published).

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK photo spots at 100 locations. The spots are marked scenic viewpoints spread across the whole state; the efficient way to 100 is a habit, not a road trip — WAiNK every spot you pass while exploring each new area for The Goodtime State, and the two trophies finish together. Left to the end, it becomes a hundred-stop errand.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase (100 locations as published).

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges from the game's challenge list — the rotating feats and world challenges the game posts as you play. Most complete in passing if you vary what you do; glance at the challenge board whenever you start a session and steer one or two deliberately, and 50 arrives well before the grind trophies do.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase (50 challenges as published).

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner beside you and escape the heat. It needs both leads together, so it belongs after Chapter 2, when Lucia and Jason are both playable. Deliberate route: with your partner along, raise exactly four stars in a fast car, then break line of sight and stay hidden — downtown parking structures, alleys and tunnels are the reliable holes — until the stars drain completely.
steps: Play as one lead with the other as your passenger or follower.
Commit crimes in view of police until the wanted level reaches four stars — no higher.
Break line of sight, hide, and wait out the full drain without being re-spotted.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase; Output Lag launch list (partner content from Chapter 2).

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level in between. Chain stores that sit close together — a petrol-station row is ideal — and keep the wanted level alive between hits: the chain breaks if the stars drain, so move directly from till to till with your partner in tow and do not hide mid-chain. The third till completes it.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase; Output Lag launch list (partner content from Chapter 2).

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — get into 100 distinct models. Every new car, bike or boat you take counts once, so swap vehicles constantly instead of keeping a single favourite; traffic variety differs by district, which makes rich neighbourhoods and the docks the best hunting. Discoveries also feed On the Spot registrations and your garage shopping list.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase (100 vehicles as published).

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies inside a single use of Combat Focus. Set the shot up before you trigger it: walk into a crowd of at least five hostiles — a gang's illegal operation from Pest Control is a crowd on demand — pre-aim at the first target, trigger Combat Focus and move target to target without wasting the meter on misses.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, Vice City International Airport — in plain terms, leave by air in a plane the airport did not schedule for you: steal one and take off. Expect instant heat; the trophy is for the departure, then lose the police at your leisure. Caution rather than missable: if a story visit is your easiest way onto the airfield, keep a manual save before it, because missions cannot be replayed. The exact trigger was still listed among the unconfirmed methods at launch (Output Lag), so if a first attempt does not pop it, vary the aircraft and how far you fly.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase; Output Lag launch list (method unconfirmed at launch; no mission replay).

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is the hint: a Rhino is the army's tank, and it runs hot. The launch reading of this hidden trophy is that it turns on meeting a Rhino up close — climbing into one or surviving the encounter when the military rolls them out at the highest wanted levels. Its 1.57% launch earn rate was the second-highest of the hidden set, which says players are tripping over it early; expect a story beat or a five-star rampage to hand it to you, and do not go tank-hunting until you have the firepower to enjoy it.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase (description and launch earn rate).

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Jewelry robberies open across Chapters 3–4 (Output Lag). Go in quiet and masked, fire nothing, and be out before a witness raises it: scout the store's exits first, park the getaway car facing out, and treat detection — not the take — as the fail state. If the alarm goes, leave and reset rather than forcing it.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase; Output Lag launch list (robbery trophies in Chapters 3–4).

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape — five separate vault jobs, and each one only counts with a clean getaway behind it. These are the heavy scores of Chapters 3–4: bring your best setup, split the work between the leads, and plan the escape route before the vault door opens. A bust mid-job wastes the whole job, so if a vault run collapses early, cut your losses and reload rather than improvising.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase (5 vaults as published); Output Lag launch list (robbery trophies in Chapters 3–4).

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. The trucks run cash routes through free roam: block one in, crack the rear doors, take the cash and vanish before the response arrives. The escape is part of the requirement — wait for the trophy to pop before you spend anything or start anything else.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — all 52 areas of the state must be visited for the map to count as explored. Most of the state reveals itself through the story and the collectible sweeps; the stubborn last few percent are usually the islands and the far Keys. Finish with a boat or seaplane circuit of the coastline and the map closes out.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase (52 areas as listed with the trophy).

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — 9 gangs, one operation apiece. The count is per gang, not per robbery: re-robbing the same gang's operation does not advance it, so keep a mental roster and always hit a fresh gang. These raids double as the perfect Gunslinger setup, since an operation's yard holds the crowd Combat Focus wants.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase (9 gangs as listed with the trophy).

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Take a character to an oceanfront bar on Ocean Beach and order the cocktail — a small, specific interaction hiding in the leisure set. Output Lag lists this among the trophies whose exact unlock method was unconfirmed at launch, so treat the oceanfront bars as the hunting ground: try it at different bars, and at sunset as well as midday, before concluding anything. It is flagged caution here only because unconfirmed one-spot interactions deserve a save behind them.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase; Output Lag launch list (method unconfirmed at launch).

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style: find a dealership with a car on the floor, get into it, and drive out through the glass front rather than the door. The description's 'classic style' is a wink at a long series tradition — the act itself is the whole requirement, and any showroom car will do.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley — the description's 'follow-through' is the bowler's term, and in practice the trophy turns on playing a game at that named alley. Bowling is also one of the nine activity types, so one visit banks progress toward Master of None at the same time.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The vaguest description in the set: 'A partnership with mass appeal.' The launch reading ties it to Lucia and Jason together — a shared moment for the pair once both are playable from Chapter 2 — and Output Lag lists its exact method among those unconfirmed at launch. Honest advice: play the partner content as it surfaces (jobs, races and downtime together) and it should arrive on its own; if you go hunting deliberately, repeat shared activities with both characters rather than solo ones.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase; Output Lag launch list (method unconfirmed at launch; partner content from Chapter 2).

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices — PlayStation tracks a count of 500 behind this description, covering dialogue and interaction choices across story conversations and the world. It is a passive grind that finishes by itself across a full playthrough if you talk to people and take the optional branches. If it is somehow your last trophy standing, repeatable world interactions are the fastest top-up.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase (tracked count of 500 as listed with the trophy).

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed at something on the second attempt, after failing it once — 'second time's the charm' is the whole riddle. Take the deliberate route with something cheap and repeatable: fail a short race or challenge once, immediately retry it, and succeed. Never burn a story mission on this: missions cannot be replayed, so a deliberate mission failure is the one expensive way to learn the lesson.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase; Output Lag launch list (no mission replay).

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange. The description gives nothing away and no trigger was confirmed at launch; the series' tradition is scripted oddities — lights over the swamp, things in the Keys that are gone when you look back. Play after dark and explore off-road in the wild parts of the map, and keep this one in the back of your mind rather than hunting it on a schedule.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase (method unconfirmed at launch, per Output Lag's list).

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by — a melee swing from a moving vehicle, not gunfire. A motorcycle makes it easy: ride slowly past a pedestrian on the sidewalk and swing as you pass. The name is the joke (ten pins, one ball, you are the ball); the knockdown is the requirement.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from the robbery circuit; run them through the laundering contacts rather than spending them raw, and the totals climb together — by the fifth bank vault in Maximum Withdrawal this count is usually close. Prioritise vaults and armored trucks if you are farming it deliberately.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase ($250,000 as published).

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — cumulative, everywhere: clothes, weapons, vehicles, garages' fittings and services all count toward the same pot. Kitting out both characters properly finishes it naturally; if it lags late in the run, vehicle upgrades are the fastest legitimate sink.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase ($100,000 as published).

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — all 8 garages on the property market. Buy them as cash allows across the playthrough rather than in one spree; they double as the storage that makes Whip It Good and On the Spot painless. The last garages are the expensive ones, so finish the robbery circuit first and let it pay.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase (8 garages as listed with the trophy).

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. When you find a keeper — a car you would rather not lose — register it in the app instead of abandoning it at the kerb. Ten distinct vehicles finish it; the garages from Little Boxes give you the room to hold them, and every discovery from Whip It Good is a candidate.
trophies.sources: Official PSN list via Exophase (10 vehicles as published).
